title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Accrual on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Points accrue to a Wanderlane Traveller Club standing on the base fare of a ticket sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands at the rate of the fare brand held. That brand fixes two quantities in these terms: the percentage of the base fare that accrues as traveller club points, and the multiplier applied to base-fare spend when tier-qualifying points are counted.

| Fare brand | Points accrued, as a percentage of the base fare | Multiplier on base-fare spend for tier-qualifying points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0 percent | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | 25 percent | 0.50 |
| Economy Classic | 50 percent | 1.00 |
| Economy Flex | 100 percent | 1.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | 125 percent | 1.25 |
| Business Saver | 150 percent | 1.50 |
| Business Flex | 200 percent | 2.00 |

In terms:

A ticket in Basic Economy Lite accrues at 0 percent of the base fare and its base-fare spend is counted at a multiplier of 0.00, so it adds to neither count. Economy Classic and Economy Flex are counted alike towards tier qualification, both at a multiplier of 1.00, although they accrue at 50 percent and at 100 percent of the base fare respectively; and a brand may accrue at a rate above its multiplier, as Business Saver does at 150 percent with a multiplier of 1.50.

On a hypothetical base fare of 800.00 dollars: in Premium Economy Select, points accrue at 125 percent of that base fare, and the spend counted towards tier qualification is 800.00 dollars multiplied by 1.25, that is 1000.00 dollars. In Economy Saver, points accrue at 25 percent of the same base fare, and the spend counted towards tier qualification is 800.00 dollars multiplied by 0.50, that is 400.00 dollars. In Business Flex, points accrue at 200 percent of it, and the tier-qualifying spend is that fare multiplied by 2.00, that is 1600.00 dollars.
